parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON m.molregno = di.molregno WHERE di.efo_term = 'chronic kidney disease' AND m.max_phase = 4 ORDER BY m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind
